key_value_text.value: 4 candidate tau-neutrino interaction events against an estimated background of 0.34 events

significance.note: No sigma-style significance figure is stated verbatim in the fetched abstract; only the candidate-event count and expected background are given.

summary.plain: DONUT's announcement that it had directly caught tau neutrinos interacting for the first time -- four clean candidate events found against almost no expected background -- completing direct detection of every particle the Standard Model predicts.
summary.technical: DONUT's analysis of 203 neutrino interactions recorded in nuclear-emulsion targets identified four candidate tau-neutrino charged-current interaction events against an estimated background of 0.34 events, the first direct observation of tau-neutrino interactions and confirmation of the tau neutrino as a distinct Standard Model particle.

title: Observation of tau neutrino interactions
why_it_matters: The tau neutrino was the last fermion of the Standard Model to be directly detected; DONUT's observation completed the experimental confirmation of the three-generation lepton structure of the Standard Model.
